projects.name: ModellingDescription: This project is related to a big Pharmaceutical company, As per the business
details: requirement, we have to work on "JANSSEN COVID -19 VACCINE VIAL" product, where we have to find out customer’s
feedback/quires after getting COVID vaccine and categories them so that ChatBot can understand and respond back to the
candidates.Here we have client’s data around 2 million in csv format in which we have to put our logic and find out the
structured data by using KMeans algorithm.
Responsibilities:
• Utilized AWS Machine Translator for translating chatbot responses of employees from 10 different
languages to English.
• Used text simplification techniques (stopword removal, punctuation removal, lemmatization) for making a text
easier to read and understand, while preserving its main ideas and approximate meaning.
• Performed lexical normalization for translating/transforming a non -standard corpus to a standard
text form.
• Performed Topic Modeling for identifying abstract Topics underlying in the collection of J&J’s covid
vaccine customer complaints data using various algorithms including LDA, NMF, KMeans.
• Developed Intent Detection tool using traditional NLP methods for capturing the semantics of chatbot transcripts
of employees in the payroll division of J&J and assigning them to the correct label
• Extracted top keywords for identifying the most relevant terms to describe subject of the obtained
intents from model.
• Created Text Summarization pipeline for shortened version of several documents belonging to the identified
intents that preserves most of their meaning using cosine similarity and Transformers T5 Base models (Hugging
Face)
• Tagged entities in text with their corresponding type, typically in BIO notation using Named Entity Recognition
techniques including StanfordNLP , count vectorizer packages.
• Built Phrases Generation pipeline using n -grams, fuzzywuzzy, sentence similarity models for
identifying the top common phrases belonging to their respective topics.
• Assisted Entity Linking to the content strategy team for recognizing and disambiguating named
entities, designing phrases, intents, and solutions to the knowledge base of J&J chatbot system.
• Created an API by utilizing Flask and imparted the plan to application group and enable them to characterize the models
Environment:Python,Tfidf,stancorenlp,Hugging-faceTransformers,spaCy,NLTK,Gensim,coreNLP,TextBlob,Pytorch
NLP, TensorFlow,BLSTM,scikit-learn,Pandas, Numpy ,Regex.
